instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the opened Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run Python, bpy scripts, Text Editor scripts, Geometry Nodes exported scripts, or blender --background automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Do not install or run helper add-ons that auto-build the required result. Use only Blender native GUI tools, menus, editors, and built-in save/export commands. Animated Grease Pencil -> Mesh Conversion Using the opened `scene.blend`, create three mesh objects named `Frame_1_Mesh`, `Frame_10_Mesh`, and `Frame_20_Mesh`, then save `answer.blend`. Their mesh data must have exactly `8 verts / 7 edges`, `12 verts / 11 edges`, and `16 verts / 15 edges` respectively. Each object must have a `hide_viewport` f-curve with at least one keyframe. At frame `1`, only `Frame_1_Mesh` may be visible; at frame `10`, only `Frame_10_Mesh`; at frame `20`, only `Frame_20_Mesh`. The original `Sketch` object may remain or be removed.
